The purpose and nature of the [[Mursaat Token]]s are currently unknown; however, they drop not just from the Mursaat themselves, but also from the [[Jade construct]]s, which share the color, possibly material as well, as the tokens. All that is known about the tokens themselves apart from this is that, according to [[Nicholas the Traveler]], they "have an untapped inner power, a power you can sense, waiting to detonate and ruin all life."

===Farming===
* [[Abaddon's Mouth]] has a large amount of the necessary foes. Just doing the mission from start to finish will expose you to a large amount of encounters. A run can be done in 10-15 minutes with good heroes.

* Enter [[Ice Floe]] from [[Thunderhead Keep]] and follow the marked path.  There are many patrols of Mursaat and Jade in the open area off the track.  Once you clear these, continue on for a few more groups along the path to [[Marhan's Grotto]].

==Collectors==
{{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|23rd November 2009 and 18th June 2012|Ice Floe|3 [[Mursaat Token]]s}}

==Notes==
* There are no known permanent [[collector]]s of Mursaat Tokens at this time.
* The design within the token is the same as the [[Ether Seal]] design.
* Some [[scam]]mers will put Mursaat Tokens up instead of [[Glob of Ectoplasm|Globs of Ectoplasm]] in trade.
